landing.badge: Runs on your phone, no internet needed
landing.hero_title: Track a diabetic foot ulcer without guessing
landing.hero_body: DiaFootCare photographs a wound and measures it, identifies the tissue, and flags signs of infection or poor blood flow — using three AI models that run on the phone itself.
landing.hero_note: Built for a clinical usability study. Not a substitute for your care team.
landing.modes_body: Choose when you first open the app, and change it later from your profile.
landing.mode_online_body: A light install. Photos are analysed on our servers, so the app downloads in seconds and stays small. Needs a connection to analyse a wound.
landing.mode_offline_body: Downloads the AI models once (~200 MB, resumable if the connection drops) and then works with no internet at all. Records sync automatically the next time you are online.
landing.step_capture_body: Take a photo of the wound with a reference object beside it for scale.
landing.step_measure_body: The wound outline is detected and converted to length, width and area in centimetres.
landing.step_analyse_body: Tissue type is classified and signs of infection or impaired blood flow are assessed.
landing.step_track_body: Every scan is stored so you and your clinician can see whether the wound is healing.
landing.features_body: Wound analysis sits alongside the daily habits that decide whether an ulcer heals.
landing.feature_segmentation_body: Automatic outline detection with calibrated length, width and area — no ruler photos to interpret by eye.
landing.feature_tissue_body: Identifies the tissue present in the wound bed, which is what changes as a wound heals or deteriorates.
landing.feature_risk_body: Highlights signs of infection or impaired blood flow, the two things that turn an ulcer into an emergency.
landing.feature_glucose_body: Log readings, daily foot checks and a care streak, because wound healing follows blood sugar control.
landing.feature_medication_body: Dose tracking with an adherence view, plus appointment reminders that fire on time.
landing.feature_accessibility_body: Arabic and English, full right-to-left support, screen-reader labels, large text, and read-aloud on key screens.
landing.privacy_body: During the study, wound records and questionnaire answers are sent to the DiaFootCare server. They are stored under your account, which means they are linked to you and to your medical records — they are not anonymous. You are shown the full declaration in the app before anything is sent.
landing.privacy_account: Stored under your account and linked to your records
landing.privacy_study: Seen by the clinical and research team running the study
landing.privacy_withdraw: You can withdraw at any time without affecting your care
landing.footer_disclaimer: For clinical study use. Not a substitute for professional medical advice.
landing.meta_title: Diabetic foot ulcer tracking that runs on your phone
landing.screenshot_alt: The DiaFootCare home screen on an Android phone, showing today's summary, a daily self-care checklist and the wound capture shortcut.
landing.fact_models_label: Segmentation, tissue type, infection and ischaemia
landing.fact_offline_label: Analysis runs on the phone, with no connection
landing.shots_body: Real screens from the app patients use, not mockups.
landing.shot_home_body: Today's glucose, foot status, next appointment and self-care progress in one place.
landing.shot_home_alt: The DiaFootCare home screen showing today's blood glucose, foot status, next appointment and a 4 of 5 self-care progress bar.
landing.shot_history_body: Every scan plotted, so improvement or deterioration is visible rather than remembered.
landing.shot_history_alt: The wound photo history screen showing 5 entries, 82 percent overall improvement and a healing trend graph.
landing.shot_selfcare_body: The five checks that decide whether an ulcer heals, tracked day by day.
landing.shot_selfcare_alt: The daily self-care screen showing an 80 percent completion ring and a checklist of five foot-care tasks.
landing.get_body: DiaFootCare runs on your phone. Take a photo of the wound and it measures the size and describes the tissue — on the phone itself, or on our server if you prefer not to download the analysis files.
landing.get_note: Android installs from a file rather than the Play Store, because this is a study build. Your phone will ask you to allow it once. Choosing offline analysis downloads about 200 MB more, one time — the app tells you before it starts.
